017package org.apache.juneau.rest.client;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.net.*;
022import java.util.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
025
026/**
027 * Pure decision logic for whether caller-set credential headers (such as {@code Authorization}
028 * or {@code Cookie}) should be forwarded or stripped when a REST call is transparently replayed
029 * against a redirect target (an HTTP {@code 3xx} response's {@code Location}).
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * This class contains only the <b>decision</b> &mdash; it does not itself intercept, follow, or
033 * rewrite any request. Each transport binding (classic, HttpClient-4.5/5.x, Jetty, OkHttp, the
034 * JDK client, etc.) is responsible for calling into this class from its own redirect hook and
035 * acting on the result.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * The policy is intentionally simple and conservative:
039 * <ul>
040 *    <li>Credentials are forwarded only when the redirect target is the <b>exact same origin</b>
041 *       as the original request &mdash; same scheme, same host (case-insensitive), and same port
042 *       (after applying the standard default port for {@code http}/{@code https}).
043 *    <li>Credentials are stripped on any other origin change (different scheme, host, or port).
044 *    <li>Credentials are stripped on an {@code https} &rarr; {@code http} scheme downgrade, even in
045 *       the (impossible under the same-origin rule above) case that host and port otherwise match.
046 * </ul>
047 *
048 * <p>
049 * Both {@code from} and {@code to} must be absolute URIs (non-{@code null} scheme and host);
050 * callers are responsible for resolving a relative {@code Location} header against the original
051 * request URI before calling into this class.
052 *
053 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
054 * <p class='bjava'>
055 *    <jk>if</jk> (RedirectSecurity.<jsm>shouldStripCredentials</jsm>(<jv>originalUri</jv>, <jv>redirectUri</jv>)) {
056 *       <jc>// remove Authorization / Cookie / etc. before replaying the request</jc>
057 *    }
058 * </p>
059 *
060 * @since 10.0.0
061 */
062public final class RedirectSecurity {
063
064   private RedirectSecurity() {}
065
066   /**
067    * The outcome of a credential-forwarding decision for a single redirect hop.
068    */
069   public enum CredentialDecision {
070
071      /** The redirect target is the same origin as the original request; credentials may be forwarded as-is. */
072      FORWARD,
073
074      /** The redirect target is cross-origin (or a scheme downgrade); credentials must be stripped before replay. */
075      STRIP
076   }
077
078   /**
079    * Returns {@code true} if {@code from} and {@code to} share the same origin &mdash; scheme,
080    * host (case-insensitive), and port (after default-port normalization for {@code http}/{@code https}).
081    *
082    * @param from The original request URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
083    * @param to The redirect target URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
084    * @return {@code true} if both URIs resolve to the same origin.
085    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If either argument is {@code null} or not an absolute URI.
086    */
087   public static boolean sameOrigin(URI from, URI to) {
088      requireAbsolute(from, "from");
089      requireAbsolute(to, "to");
090      return from.getScheme().equalsIgnoreCase(to.getScheme())
091         && from.getHost().equalsIgnoreCase(to.getHost())
092         && normalizedPort(from) == normalizedPort(to);
093   }
094
095   /**
096    * Returns {@code true} if the redirect represents an {@code https} &rarr; {@code http} scheme
097    * downgrade.
098    *
099    * @param from The original request URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
100    * @param to The redirect target URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
101    * @return {@code true} if {@code from} is {@code https} and {@code to} is {@code http}.
102    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If either argument is {@code null} or not an absolute URI.
103    */
104   public static boolean isDowngrade(URI from, URI to) {
105      requireAbsolute(from, "from");
106      requireAbsolute(to, "to");
107      return "https".equalsIgnoreCase(from.getScheme()) && "http".equalsIgnoreCase(to.getScheme());
108   }
109
110   /**
111    * Decides whether credentials should be forwarded or stripped for a single redirect hop.
112    *
113    * @param from The original request URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
114    * @param to The redirect target URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
115    * @return {@link CredentialDecision#STRIP} unless {@code to} is the exact same origin as
116    *    {@code from} (and not a scheme downgrade), in which case {@link CredentialDecision#FORWARD}.
117    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If either argument is {@code null} or not an absolute URI.
118    */
119   public static CredentialDecision decide(URI from, URI to) {
120      return shouldStripCredentials(from, to) ? CredentialDecision.STRIP : CredentialDecision.FORWARD;
121   }
122
123   /**
124    * Convenience boolean form of {@link #decide(URI, URI)}.
125    *
126    * @param from The original request URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
127    * @param to The redirect target URI. Must be absolute (non-{@code null} scheme and host).
128    * @return {@code true} if credentials must be stripped before replaying the request against {@code to}.
129    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If either argument is {@code null} or not an absolute URI.
130    */
131   public static boolean shouldStripCredentials(URI from, URI to) {
132      return ! sameOrigin(from, to) || isDowngrade(from, to); // HTT: isDowngrade's true-branch is unreachable here -- it's only reached when sameOrigin is true, which requires equal schemes, but isDowngrade requires https-vs-http (unequal schemes); likely-dead defensive code, flagged rather than removed.
133   }
134
135   /**
136    * Returns the header names that must be stripped from a request before it is replayed
137    * cross-origin. Reuses the canonical credential-header set from {@link RedactedHeaders#DEFAULT}.
138    *
139    * @return The set of header names to strip on a cross-origin (or downgraded) redirect.
140    */
141   public static Set<String> stripOnCrossOrigin() {
142      return RedactedHeaders.DEFAULT;
143   }
144
145   private static int normalizedPort(URI uri) {
146      var port = uri.getPort();
147      if (port != -1)
148         return port;
149      return switch (uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
150         case "https" -> 443;
151         case "http" -> 80;
152         default -> -1;
153      };
154   }
155
156   private static void requireAbsolute(URI uri, String argName) {
157      if (uri == null)
158         throw iaex("Argument '%s' must not be null", argName);
159      if (uri.getScheme() == null || uri.getHost() == null)
160         throw iaex("Argument '%s' must be an absolute URI with a scheme and host: %s", argName, uri);
161   }
162}
